harnesses.name: Claude Code
harnesses.notes: worker-start --model pin honoured. The two discovery probes are answered locally (num_turns 0, total_cost_usd 0, no model turn); do not treat them as a dispatch. Trust is a dialog. A fresh repository shows the trust dialog even with --dangerously-skip-permissions, with No, exit preselected, reproduced 2026-09-11 on Claude Code 2.1.268; a worktree of an already-trusted repository inherits trust and shows none, which is what the withdrawn 2026-09-04 probe actually measured — do not re-propose that 2026-09-04 reading. Claude Code 2.1.273 and 2.1.274 word the dialog 'Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust?' with 'No, exit' preselected, so Enter refuses and exits the harness. Orca's prompt delivery sends Enter into that dialog, which is why a NO_ACK or PREFLIGHT FAIL quote on an untrusted path ends at a shell prompt and may hold only the tail 'Security guide' within the helper's 400-character quote (measured 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-17).

harnesses.name: Codex CLI
harnesses.notes: Codex CLI 0.154.0 shows its own trust dialog on a fresh directory ('Do you trust the contents of this directory?'), measured 2026-09-16 during the 0.19.0 checklist; trust is dialog, not orca-preflight. Control wakes by waker. Discovery: slugs with visibility hide are not offered; effort levels are supported_reasoning_levels on each slug, not one vocabulary per harness. Native AGENTS.md reader; CLAUDE.md is inert (not imported). '› 1. Yes, continue' is preselected, so Enter grants trust (measured 2026-09-16 on 0.154.0). 2026-09-11, Orca 1.4.199: a gpt-5.6-terra medium Control slept, 3 turns for a two-worker cycle. 2026-09-16, 0.20.0 candidate: a gpt-5.6-sol high Control ended its turn after each wait-bg, one request per wait, and notify started a new turn. 2026-09-17, 0.20.0: a gpt-5.6-terra medium Control kept its turn open in 2 of 2 runs, looping orca terminal wait about every 35 s (6 requests in a 118 s wait); in one of them it launched dely wait-bg inside a new Orca terminal, so the waiter watched the wrong terminal and failed. A gpt-5.6-sol medium Control slept (requests only in the first 18 s of each wait, 3 turns). Whether a Codex Control sleeps is not a stable property of the model; record the Control model with each probe row. Codex's default model is now gpt-6-astra high, not measured as Control.

harnesses.name: Grok Build
harnesses.notes: Deferred. Control wakes by waker. Grok Build 1.0.30 asks a y/n security question in a fresh repository (measured 2026-09-14), so trust is dialog, not none. Opens at the composer with no workspace-trust surface (measured 2026-08-29; unconfirmed by the 2026-09-11 method that retracted the Claude result — re-measure before relying on it). Grok validates root plugin.json (name and description only). worker-start --model does not support this id; models come from Orca's per-agent default arguments. PATH agent collides with this binary, so Cursor must not be documented as agent. No discovery command is offered while deferred.

harnesses.name: Antigravity CLI
harnesses.notes: Deferred. worker-start --agent agy returns agent_unconfigured; the id that resolves is antigravity. Control wakes by waker. 0.18.0 launched via an adopt path after output quiescence because a plain worker-start typed the prompt before the TUI was ready (0 of 4 on 2026-09-11); 0.19.0 deleted that path, so Antigravity workers no longer launch. Discovery while supported was agy models (TSV, offer the slug column) and effort low|medium|high from CLI help; some slugs already end in -high/-medium/-low — do not strip those suffixes. Native AGENTS.md; do not offer GEMINI.md. Root plugin.json is the agy package (name and description only; additionalProperties false). Install is agy plugin install of the git URL or a local path; the CLI has no plugin update. Do not write ~/.gemini. worker-start --model does not support this id; models come from Orca's per-agent default arguments.

harnesses.name: Kiro CLI
harnesses.notes: Deferred. worker-start --agent kiro-cli returns agent_unconfigured; the id that resolves is kiro. Control wake is unsupported. permissionDefault is none; --trust-all-tools is forbidden on the launch argv because it opens a confirmation whose default is No, exit, and Orca's Enter kills the session. Once the TUI is idle, /tools trust-all was observed to trust tools for the session with no confirmation dialog. Headless kiro-cli chat --no-interactive is not a Dely worker. Native AGENTS.md. Discovery while supported was kiro-cli chat --list-models --format json (offer each model_id) and effort from kiro-cli chat --help; live 2.16.2 may offer only auto. Install is npx skills targeting the kiro-cli agent at global scope. No workspace-trust surface (measured 2026-08-29; unconfirmed by the 2026-09-11 method that retracted the Claude result — re-measure before relying on it). Do not write ~/.kiro or create custom agents. worker-start --model does not support this id; models come from Orca's per-agent default arguments.

harnesses.name: Cursor Agent CLI
harnesses.notes: worker-start --model pin honoured; omit --effort (there is no effort flag; write the literal default). worker-start --agent cursor-agent returns agent_unconfigured; the id that resolves is cursor. Offer the model slug before ' - '. Do not invent an effort vocabulary, strip effort suffixes from slugs, or synthesize parameterized [effort=…] forms. Native AGENTS.md reader; the CLI also applies CLAUDE.md as a rule, so that file is not inert, but the import write offer stays on entries with needsImport. Never PATH agent (collides with Grok). Never -w/--worktree. Do not put --trust or an unpinned --sandbox on the launch argv. Trust dialog on a fresh directory, measured 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-17 on Cursor Agent 2026.09.10-fd3934a and 2026.09.15-d2fe57e: '⚠ Workspace Trust Required … Do you trust the contents of this directory?' with '▶ [a] Trust this workspace' preselected over '[q] Quit', so `a` or Enter grants trust, and the screen shows '⏳ Trusting workspace...' before the composer. Text sent in that state was dropped while `orca terminal send` returned ok; wait for the composer before sending a prompt.

harnesses.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
harnesses.notes: Deferred. Control wakes by background. --allow-all is the documented equivalent of --allow-all-tools --allow-all-paths --allow-all-urls, with --yolo as its alias. No non-interactive model listing: copilot models fails with Invalid command format; copilot -p "/model" dispatched a real turn (auto-routed to claude-haiku-4.5). An unavailable --model value prints Using "auto" instead and continues. Effort while supported was from copilot --help: none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max. Native AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md reader (--no-custom-instructions disables both). Trust: Confirm folder trust still opens with --allow-all (1. Yes preselected; never 2, which remembers the folder). Restore interrupted sessions then lists sessions from other folders; Esc starts fresh, Enter is a wrong-session hazard. Measured 2026-08-31 on Copilot CLI 1.0.82: Orca documented no copilot launcher id, so Control composed copilot --allow-all --effort high by hand. Install uses existing manifests into ~/.copilot/installed-plugins/dely/dely/; no sidecar. worker-start --model does not support this id; models come from Orca's per-agent default arguments.
